id: # Coop mod rule additions. Starsector merges a mod's data/campaign/rules.csv onto the vanilla
# ruleset, so only the added/overriding rows live here.
# (1) COOP TEST START -- a 6th option in the "Your most recent occupation was as..." list.
# Grants a Ziggurat + 1,000,000 credits + crew/supplies/fuel so two clients can get into a
# real fight without grinding an early game first. Chains into NGCDifficultyOptions, exactly
# like the vanilla explorer/merc/freelancer options, so the rest of creation is unchanged.
# MUST be gated or removed before any public release -- see docs/PHASE14_SPIKE_NOTES.md.
coopZigguratStart
script:
SetTooltip coopZiggurat "COOP TEST START - not intended for normal play.

A Ziggurat-class phase battleship (Experimental variant), 1,000,000 credits, and a full complement of crew, supplies and fuel.

Exists so a coop session can start with something worth fighting over."
options: 6:coopZiggurat:COOP TEST - a phase experiment survivor, commanding a Ziggurat (1,000,000 credits)

id: coopZigguratPicked
script:
NGCAddShip ziggurat_Experimental
NGCAddCredits 1000000
NGCAddCargo RESOURCES crew 50
NGCAddCargo RESOURCES supplies 100
NGCAddCargo RESOURCES fuel 150
FireAll NGCDifficultyOptions

id: # (2) FORCED TUTORIAL SKIP -- for every start option, not just the coop test start.
# The vanilla tutorial rewrites Galatia system state (TutorialMissionIntel, respawn flags, the
# Ancyra/Jangala contacts), which would diverge host and guest in a seed-locked coop campaign.
# Skipping is correct coop behaviour, not just a test shortcut.
# These two rows outscore the vanilla ngcEasyPicked/ngcNormalPicked rows (NewGameOptionSelected
# is dispatched via FireBest, so highest condition score wins) and replace their
# "FireAll NGCTutorialOptions" with the body of the vanilla ngcSkipTutorialPicked rule. Nothing
# else fires NGCTutorialOptions, so the tutorial question is never asked. This also bypasses the
# vanilla NGCCanSkipTutorial gate, which is intended -- a fresh profile can still start coop.
# The spacer start (option 5) already skips the tutorial on its own path and is untouched.
# Revisit at Phase 23 packaging -- see docs/PHASE14_SPIKE_NOTES.md.
coopNgcEasyPicked
script:
NGCSetDifficulty easy
$ngcSkipTutorial = true
NGCAddCharacterPoints 1
NGCSetStartingLocation Corvus -2500 3000
NGCAddStandardStartingScript
NGCDone

id: coopNgcNormalPicked
script:
NGCSetDifficulty normal
$ngcSkipTutorial = true
NGCAddCharacterPoints 1
NGCSetStartingLocation Corvus -2500 3000
NGCAddStandardStartingScript
NGCDone
